messages:
sam: heads-up — noticed a spike in duplicate final events for SSE streams from the webhook proxy since the canary roll. billing shows ~2x token counts for affected routes. anyone else seeing this?

maria: saw the alert, digging. reproducing locally now with the canary header.

oliver: link to quick grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/streams/streaming-errors?orgId=1&var-route=customer-x : surge at 11:03 UTC

zara: sample log from edge: 
```
[11:03:12.345] conn=abc123 recv: {"type":"chunk","data":"..."}
[11:03:12.346] conn=abc123 send: :done
[11:03:12.347] conn=abc123 proxy-resume: resuming session
[11:03:12.348] conn=abc123 send: {"type":"chunk","data":"..."}  <-- duplicate final
```

sam: interesting, proxy emits :done then resume path replays last chunk. looks like an off-by-one in resume replay window. :thinking:

infra-bot: @channel deploy-canary v2.4.7 started on proxy-pool-3

maria: repro script i used (curl SSE):
```
curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  -H "X-Canary: yes" \ 
  'https://api.redwood/v1/stream?route=customer-x' | sed -n '1,50p'
```

maria: observed duplicate final chunk ~30% of runs when resume kicks in within 10ms of :done.

oliver: hypothesis: resume logic doesn't check last-sent sequence id for terminal frames. when resume applies, it replays N frames including the final one. if :done was already flushed, client ends up with duplicate.

zara: console folks — this explains the billing delta, but we also should make dashboard note for 'duplicate terminal frames' so customers don't panic. pinging @console-team

console-team: got it. can we add a metric tag on resume: replayed_final=true/false? if we can emit that to tracing we can break down affected customers.

tim: quick fix idea: when proxy sees :done for a session, attach a terminal-seq marker; resume should trim any replayed frames >= terminal-seq. low-risk guard.

sam: agree. we should also add idempotency on server-side billing: dedupe tokens for identical chunk+seq within 2s window to avoid immediate double-charge.

maria: PR incoming for proxy: https://git.redwood/proxy/compare/fix/resume-trim (still drafting). it adds terminal-seq and a replay-trim step.

oliver: test plan: stress with jittered resume timings + enable canary header. measure duplicate events count and tokens billed. we also need unit test for resume window logic.

zara: console: will add a temporary banner and a dashboard panel showing 'suspected duplicates' and cost impact for last 6h. good to have until fix rolls.

console-team: added minimal panel and a work-item on UX to surface 'working on duplicate final chunk bug' to affected orgs.

tim: rollout plan — ship proxy fix to canary pool, monitor replay-trim metric and billing dedupe rate. if clean for 30m, promote. fallback plan: disable resume on proxy-pool-3 to stop replays immediately.

sam: who owns the rollout?

maria: i'll own canary deploy + tests. oliver do you want to run post-deploy validation script?

oliver: on it. i'll run the script and post results here.

infra-bot: deploy-canary v2.4.7 to proxy-pool-3 completed (id: dc-991).

maria: canary running. initial validation: duplicates dropped from 31% -> 1.2% in first 5m. posting full logs in thread.

oliver: looks good. monitoring shows token-rate normalizing.

sam: thanks y'all. after we promote, follow-up items: 1) add replay-trim QA into release checklist, 2) add server-side token dedupe (billing), 3) retrospective note for resume semantics and console messaging.

zara: i'll schedule quick postmortem doc and include console timeline. :white_check_mark:

sam: great — closing loop. anyone want to write the incident blurb for all-hands? short note + link to console panel.

oliver: i'll draft it.

console-team: leaving note in ops-wiki and assigned follow-ups.

sam: ok closing thread once oliver posts the all-hands blurb. thanks!
